name: skill-generalizer
title_zh: 私人 skill 洗成能公开上架的那一版
tagline_zh: 本地路径、内网域名、你的口头禅、写死的 token，全都会被替换成占位符；改完还给你一份逐行 diff。
tagline_en: Strips local paths, internal hosts, personal habits and hardcoded tokens into placeholders, then hands you a.
desc_en: Use when turning local, private, or personal Agent Skills into publishable skills for GitHub, marketplaces, teams, or public sharing, especially when private paths, personal habits, credentials, internal hosts, or user-specific context must be removed.
why_zh: 先扫敏感面再重写措辞，两步分开做，所以不会为了脱敏把 skill 的原有判断力一起洗掉。
why_en: Scans for sensitive surfaces first, rewrites wording second — so sanitizing never washes away the skill's original judgment.
limit_zh: 只处理纯文本类 skill 文件（SKILL.md、脚本、配置片段），二进制、图片。
limit_en: Text-based skill files only (SKILL.md, scripts, config snippets). Binary, images and notebook outputs are untouched; credentials are pattern-matched.
title_en: Private skill scrubbed into a publishable release, with a.
